name: Ghost Hair Thread
summary: In Darkshire, Madame Eva spins Ghost Hair Thread from the spirit world. Its occult powers can bind spirits or stitch life into inanimate things. Abercrombie asks for it to ward his shack against restless ghosts.

sections.title: Spun of the Spirit World
sections.body: Madame Eva spins Ghost Hair Thread in Darkshire, where its strange powers are known. Eva says the spectral strand can bind malevolent spirits or stitch vitality into inanimate objects. In Duskwood, it can be used in rituals and wards.

sections.title: Abercrombie's Ward
sections.body: Abercrombie lives in a ramshackle shack just north of Raven Hill Cemetery. The hermit asks travelers to bring him Ghost Hair Thread from Darkshire. He says he needs to string it across his windows and doorframe to keep wandering undead from entering his home. What else might the thread do?

faq.answer: Madame Eva spins Ghost Hair Thread in Darkshire. Its occult powers can bind spirits or stitch life into inanimate things.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want Ghost Hair Thread?
faq.answer: Abercrombie says he needs Ghost Hair Thread across his windows and doorway to ward off restless spirits near Raven Hill Cemetery.
Madame Eva, Darkshire's fortune teller, spins the thread and provides it upon request.

faq.q: Can players use the thread for tailoring?
aliases: can i craft with ghost hair thread
faq.answer: No. Ghost Hair Thread cannot be used in standard tailoring recipes; it is meant for Abercrombie.

angles.text: Tailors usually work with wool, silk, and mageweave. Madame Eva's ghostly thread shows that fabric can also be spun from supernatural essences and hold enchantments.
As a warlock, you may recognize the thread's power to bind spirits and give life to inanimate matter from the dark arts of soul manipulation and construct binding.
